content:
We have a task: build complete route of chemicals based on inputs. We have template search result with mapped_rxn and template_id 1914386. Apply_template gave precursors list: ["C#C[Si](C)(C)C", "COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1"].

But verify_step says false: applying template to those precursors does not give target molecule? Wait target molecule is maybe the product? The product from template is the target molecule (the one we are retrosynthesizing). The target molecule likely is the product in the mapped_rxn: the right side? Let's examine mapped_rxn: "[CH:14]#[C:15][Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19].O=[C:5]([C:3]([O:2][CH3:1])=[O:4])[CH2:6][CH2:7][c:8]1[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]1>>[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1(/[CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2)[CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]"

Left side (reactants) are: "[CH:14]#[C:15][Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]" which is C#C[Si](C)(C)C (makes sense) and "O=[C:5]([C:3]([O:2][CH3:1])=[O:4])[CH2:6][CH2:7][c:8]1[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]1" which is maybe "COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1"? Let's check: O=[C:5]([C:3]([O:2][CH3:1])=[O:4])... That seems like a carbonyl attached to a chain with phenyl. The SMILES "COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1" is methyl ester? Actually COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1 is methyl 2-oxo-... Let's trust.

Right side product is "[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1(/[CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2)[CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]". That's a cyclic product with a silyl alkyne? Actually includes Si.

Thus the target molecule (product) is that SMILES. We need to build route: starting from target product, we have a retrosynthetic step using template 1914386 to break into two precursors: C#C[Si](C)(C)C and COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1.

Now we need to ensure both precursors are buyable? Possibly need to check is_buyable. Let's check.
